description: Gaining ownership of you is allowing things to come and go #selflove #selfimprovement #letgo
transcript: I've learned to allow everything to come and go, and it is really that simple. I've learned to connect with everything and attach to nothing. I am not attached to any outcome, strong steward of my life, and that looks like not allowing others to negatively impact my life, but allowing others to be a mirror image. Everything that I do is with the lens of intention. I value my life, and I value having full input on it.
